build_step3p5_model: build a vLLM Step3p5 causal language model with MoE layers and tensor parallel support
create_step3p5_decoder_layer: create a decoder layer with attention, MoE or MLP block, and RMS normalization
run_step3p5_forward: run the Step3p5ForCausalLM forward pass with input ids, positions, and optional intermediate tensors
load_step3p5_weights: load model weights with support for per-expert MoE, packed QKV, and HF-to-vLLM weight mapping
test_step3p5_attention: test the Step3p5Attention module with sliding window, rope scaling, and QK normalization
